question: Where can I get a list of public electric vehicle charging points in Spain, with location, operator, power (kW) and number of connectors?

answer.summary: Yes: the Ministry (MITECO) keeps a national census of public-access charging points (RIPREE), republished daily as a DATEX II XML feed on the DGT National Access Point. The feed has 12,114 sites, 35,905 points and 43,097 connectors with exact coordinates, operator (CPO) and max power per connector. Reserve: no live availability or price in it; completeness against the real network is not checked.
main_caveats: Power unit differs by file: DATEX maxPowerAtSocket is in watts (350000.0 = 350 kW); RIPREE CSV/XML carries text like '350,00 kW'. Divide by 1000 only for the DATEX feed.
Rows are not points: RIPREE CSV/XML has one row per connector (43,098); DATEX nests connectors in 35,905 refill points inside 12,114 sites. 4,999 points have 2+ connectors.
Only public-access points reported by registered CPOs are included. Availability and price (needed only for points of 43 kW or more) are not in these files; REVE shows them as a viewer only.
Completeness against the real network is unverified: registered operators number 163 and no independent total was opened. Per-site lastUpdated dates range from 2023 to 2026.
In the DATEX feed postcodes lose the leading zero (3,388 sites have under five digits) and typeOfSite is missing for 1,217 sites; the RIPREE CSV/XML keep the zero.
answer.confidence_reason: Both official files were downloaded and parsed in full; counts agree (12,114 sites, 35,905 points). Only completeness against the real network was not checked.

attributes.note: 12,114 sites with lat/lon (0 outside Spain), address, municipality, province, region.
CPO legal name and code per site (163 distinct operators). It is the operator, not the site owner.
Max power per connector: watts in DATEX feed (350000.0), kW text in RIPREE CSV/XML (350,00 kW).
No count field: count connector elements per refill point (43,097 in total over 35,905 points).
